## Service: custom-menus (Custom menus API)

Documentation for Custom menus API

### Create Custom Menu Link
POST /custom-menus/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/custom-menus/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/custom-menus/create-custom-menu | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/custom-menus/create-custom-menu.md

Creates a new custom menu for a company. Requires authentication and proper permissions. For Icon Usage Details please refer to  https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-243696/d60fa70db6b92b2

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: custom-menu-link.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateCustomMenuDTO:
- title* string (e.g. "Custom Menu") - Title of the custom menu
- url* string (e.g. "https://custom-menus.com/") - URL of the custom menu
- icon* object - Icon information for the custom menu
  - name* string (e.g. "yin-yang") - Name of the icon
  - fontFamily* string (enum: fab | fas | far) - Font family of the icon
- showOnCompany* boolean (default: true) - Whether the menu must be displayed on the agency's level
- showOnLocation* boolean (default: true) - Whether the menu must be displayed for sub-accounts level
- showToAllLocations* boolean (default: true) - Whether the menu must be displayed to all sub-accounts
- openMode* string (enum: iframe | new_tab | current_tab) - Mode for opening the menu link
- locations* string[] (e.g. ["gfWreTIHL8pDbggBb7af","67WreTIHL8pDbggBb7ty"]) - List of sub-account IDs where the menu should be shown. This list is applicable only when showOnLocation is true and showToAllLocations is false
- userRole* string (enum: all | admin | user) - Which user-roles should the menu be accessible to?
- allowCamera boolean - Whether to allow camera access (only for iframe mode)
- allowMicrophone boolean - Whether to allow microphone access (only for iframe mode)

Response 201 (Custom menu successfully created) application/json:
- customMenu object - Single Custom menu link object
  - id string - Unique identifier for the custom menu
  - icon object - Icon information for the menu item
    - name string - Name of the icon
    - fontFamily string (enum: fab | fas | far) - Font family of the icon
  - title string - Title of the custom menu
  - url string - URL of the custom menu
  - order number - Order of the custom menu
  - showOnCompany boolean - Filter to show only agency-level menu links. When omitted, fetches both agency and sub-account menu links. Ignored if locationId is provided
  - showOnLocation boolean - Whether the menu must be displayed for sub-accounts level
  - showToAllLocations boolean - Whether the menu must be displayed to all sub-accounts
  - locations string[] - List of sub-account IDs where the menu should be shown. This list is applicable only when showOnLocation is true and showToAllLocations is false
  - openMode string (enum: iframe | new_tab | current_tab) - Mode for opening the menu link
  - userRole string (enum: all | admin | user) - Which user-roles should the menu be accessible to?
  - allowCamera boolean - Indicates if camera access is allowed for this menu
  - allowMicrophone boolean - Indicates if microphone access is allowed for this menu

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 422 (401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Bad Request - Invalid input): no body
Response 403 (Forbidden - Insufficient permissions): no body

### Delete Custom Menu Link
DELETE /custom-menus/{customMenuId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/custom-menus/{customMenuId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/custom-menus/delete-custom-menu | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/custom-menus/delete-custom-menu.md

Removes a specific custom menu from the system. This operation requires authentication and proper permissions. The custom menu is identified by its unique ID, and the operation is performed within the context of a specific company.

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: custom-menu-link.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- customMenuId* string (e.g. "62e589c1-c456-47e1-a9a7-cb8900014311") - ID of the custom menu to delete

Response 200 (Custom menu successfully deleted) application/json:
- success boolean - Indicates whether the custom menu was successfully deleted
- message string - A message providing additional information about the deletion operation
- deletedMenuId string - The ID of the deleted custom menu
- deletedAt string (format: date-time) - Timestamp of when the deletion was performed

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 422 (401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Bad Request. Invalid parameters provided.): no body
Response 403 (Forbidden. The client does not have necessary permissions to delete this custom menu.): no body
Response 404 (Not Found. The specified custom menu does not exist or has already been deleted.): no body
